title: Great Nautical Experience with Friends
text: Sailing through Barcelona on this boat was spectacular. The views are stunning and the service first rate. Perfect to enjoy the city from the sea. 100% recommended
author: eruizmi

title: Must do in Barcelona
text: My friends and I had an awesome experience! We were treated really well, and the crew was super nice. Overall, a must do if you are in Barcelona!
author: franchoc216

title: Amazing.
text: It was me and some friends to spend a day in the boat and I would come back without any doubt. Excellent treatment, super attentive. If you can, let me grab the DJ on board, it was the last!!

title: Unforgettable experience
text: This summer of 2024 I had the opportunity to enjoy an unforgettable experience aboard a magnificent ship. Undoubtedly, a luxury experience that I would repeat without thinking. Highly recommended!

title: Of the best experiences renting boats
text: Excellent service, very attentive, friendly and everything as advertised on the website. I also have to mention that the boat was clean. We will definitely repeat!!
author: Culture53686208681

title: Amazing Yacht Trip in Barcelona!
text: Our family had an unforgettable time on this yacht trip! The boat was beautiful, the crew was friendly and professional, and the views of Barcelona were stunning. We loved the mix of relaxation and adventure, with plenty of time to swim and soak in the sights. Highly recommend for a perfect day on the water!
author: paulaE3099UZ

title: A must do in Barcelona
text: From the moment we stepped on board, everything was perfectly arranged. The crew was super friendly and accommodating, making sure we had everything we needed. There were speakers on board so we could play our own music, creating the perfect atmosphere as we cruised along the coast. The highlight of the trip was the private chef who prepared the most delicious meals right on the boat – not only was the food incredible, but watching the chef in action was a real treat! It was the perfect mix of relaxation, great food, and fun.
author: V3909UFelenar

title: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
text: The crew was incredibly helpful and attentive, ensuring every detail was perfectly prepared for us. The snacks were not only delicious but beautifully presented, adding a touch of luxury to the trip. We even had a bartender on board, serving up delicious cocktails that we enjoyed as the sun began to set. The sunset over the Barcelona skyline was breathtaking, especially while listening to the live DJ, who set the perfect vibe for the evening. It was an unforgettable experience, and I wouldn’t miss it if I were back in Barcelona again! Highly recommend!
author: Culture35099012410
